name: EgoLife
tagline: 300 h of egocentric video of 6 people living together for 7 days (Aria glasses, 15 GoPros, mmWave), with captions, ASR and 3K QAs.

annotations.format: MP4 video + SRT captions + JSON QA + CSV (gaze, IMU, radar)
annotations.coverageNote: 361K narrations merged into 25K captions over the week; ~50 h ASR; EgoLifeQA has 3,000 MCQs (500 per person). HF repo notes data cleaning is ongoing.

narrations.note: 361K dense narrations (avg 2.65 s) merged into 25K visual-audio captions (SRT)

action_labels.note: Event/activity labels listed in the paper's dataset card

gaze.note: Aria eye-gaze CSV per recording (paper's dataset card)

audio_transcript.note: ASR transcripts (~50 h), split per participant and manually reviewed

qa_language.note: EgoLifeQA: 3,000 MCQs in 5 types (EntityLog, EventRecall, HabitInsight, ...)
